text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert for service `auth-service` — P1: Token validation errors spike. PD: https://pagerduty.example/INC2468101210 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Trigger: auth-service.token-validate.errors > 200/min for 3m. Affected endpoints: /v1/token/validate, /v1/session/verify.

alex: acked. I'm on it. seeing a big rise in 5xx and 401s from the token-validate cluster, started at ~2468101160.

cheng: +1. Logs show lots of "kid not found" and "signature verification failed" from the JWT verifier. Example log: `jwt: kid k1 not present in jwks`

maria: are we in the middle of key rotation? I pushed a JWKS rotation earlier this morning to switch to the new signing key.

alex: timeline matches. rotation completed ~2468099000. possible propagation issue between key registry and federated jwks cache.

sre_lead: quick customer impact check — graph shows token-validate error rate at 23% global, spikes higher in eu-west-1. That explains some 401s from downstream services. We should consider enabling fallback signing key or rolling back the rotation.

cheng: quick checks: 
```
curl -sS https://jwks.redwood-inference.internal/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'
# output: "k2", "k3"  <-- k1 missing
```

alex: apps still trying to validate tokens signed with k1. Some clients have cached tokens. If we re-enable legacy key k1 in JWKS, it should stop failures until tokens expire.

maria: agree. Plan: (1) toggle jwks-service config to include legacy_kids: ["k1"] (2) restart jwks cache instances in eu-west-1. (3) monitor auth success rate.

sre_lead: do it. Use canary to avoid adding an attacker vector — add k1 only to jwks-cached-0 first.

alex: patching configmap now.

ops-bot: Running: `kubectl -n auth svc/jwks-service patch deployment jwks-cached --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/-","value":{"name":"LEGACY_KIDS","value":"k1"}}]'`

ops-bot: rolling restart initiated for jwks-cached-0

cheng: verifying jwks after restart:
```
curl -sS https://jwks-cached-0.eu-west-1.svc/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'
# output: "k2", "k3", "k1"
```

alex: auth errors dropping in eu-west-1. global error rate down from 23% -> 6% in 6 minutes. still elevated in ap-southeast though.

maria: spinning the rest of the pool with the same patch now. ops-bot doing a controlled rollout.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-escalation to Sr Oncall in 10m if not acknowledged by sr_oncall.

sre_lead: I'll jump in to own comms and RCA. alex, cheng — once all jwks instances have legacy_kids we should plan a proper fix: either ensure rotation writes to central registry and invalidates caches or implement signed key fallback in verifier. Also add an automated smoke test post-rotation.

emily-cs: customer impact: CS reporting top-of-stack errors for 12 customers, mostly EU. Drafting status update: "We're experiencing intermittent authentication failures impacting session validation. Root cause under investigation; mitigation in progress. We will post updates every 30 minutes." Want a brief confirmation before I send.

maria: send with this note: "Mitigation: re-enabled legacy signing key in JWKS to allow tokens signed prior to rotation to validate. No action required from customers."

emily-cs: sending now. cc @support_team :envelope:

alex: after full rollout, errors back to baseline ~0.5% within 20 minutes. We should keep monitoring for token spoof attempts — adding k1 reintroduces acceptance of older tokens.

sre_lead: agree. short-term mitigations done. Next steps: 
- revert legacy_kids once all active sessions that use k1 have expired (TTL = 1h)
- implement stronger propagation guarantees for JWKS (write-through cache invalidation)
- add preshift smoke tests and alert thresholds for JWKS/key mismatch
- postmortem owner: maria (P1 auth-jwks-rotation-mismatch)

maria: taking postmortem. I'll collect timeline and assign action items.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and mitigation in progress. PagerDuty note: incident auto-escalation cancelled.

sre_lead: handing off to maria for the postmortem and follow-ups. I'll remain on-call for any further escalations. Handoff at 2468103010.

emily-cs: posted customer update and created support ticket list for affected accounts.

alex: closing loop — make sure we add a runbook step for key rotations: verify presence of new key AND that old key remains resolvable until tokens expire, plus an automated smoke check against token validation.

ops-bot: CI/CD DeployBot: config patch and rolling restart completed for 5 pods in eu-west-1 and 3 pods in global cache.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll kick off the postmortem doc and share draft in ~2h.

cheng: leaving a note in kubernetes: `kubectl get pods -n auth -l app=jwks-cached -o wide` shows all READY=1/1.

alex: resolved for now. will re-open thread if anything flares. :white_check_mark:
